description: Show one meeting time in several time zones. Send the date and time as read on the clock in from_zone (an IANA name such as America/New_York; UTC for a UTC time) and up to 25 IANA zones in to_zones. Get back, for each zone, the local date, time, weekday, UTC offset, zone abbreviation, whether daylight saving time is in effect, whether the date moved a day, whether the time falls inside the hours you call working hours, and the next clock change in that zone within 14 days (so a weekly meeting that will shift is flagged). A clock time that does not exist (skipped when clocks go forward) or happens twice (when clocks go back) is flagged and read the RFC 5545 way, with the other reading given. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/time-zone-convert). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

date.description: Date as read in from_zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

from_zone.description: IANA time zone of that clock time, e.g. America/Chicago, Asia/Kolkata, UTC.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'weekly sync' (your own text, echoed).

repeated_time.description: When from_zone's clock shows the time twice (clocks going back): first (default, RFC 5545) or second occurrence.

time.description: Time as read on the clock in from_zone, 24-hour HH:MM.

to_zones.description: IANA time zones to show the time in (1 to 25).

work_end.description: End of working hours for the within_hours flag, HH:MM (default 17:00).

work_start.description: Start of working hours for the within_hours flag, HH:MM (default 09:00).
